title: Distribution of 400 Educational Apps - 1
summary: Rotary Club of Bombay Airport facilitated the distribution of 400 educational apps for Class 10 SSC Board students to support their learning and examination preparation.
description: Rotary Club of Bombay Airport facilitated the distribution of 400 educational apps for Class 10 SSC Board students to support their learning and examination preparation. The apps were distributed across four Interact Club schools affiliated with the SSC Board and two schools in Neral, including Gandhi Shikshan Bhavan School. Demo links were shared with each school principal, who appreciated the app's design and usefulness for students. Representatives from IDEAL STUDY APP, Ms Vandana and Mr Amole, explained the app's content to students and teachers and provided demonstrations. PP Ujwal Andhari sponsored 200 apps after personally reviewing their authenticity and usefulness, while Rtn Sitaram Churiwala sponsored the remaining 200 apps. PP Ashmi Parekh facilitated the project.
location: Gandhi Shikshan Bhavan School, Mumbai, Maharashtra
